title: Inspect compiled map preview
summary: Open a built .d3dbsp and compare its compiled surfaces with the current editor map.
outcome: A compiled preview with understood visual limits.

sections.title: Enter compiled preview

steps.title: Open compiled data
steps.text: Choose Build → Preview last built .d3dbsp after a successful build in this editor session, or Open .d3dbsp preview to choose a local file.

steps.title: Read the banner
steps.text: Inspect the preview banner for the BSP filename, relationship to the open map, and any asset, lightmap, water, or renderer notice.

steps.title: Compare deliberately
steps.text: Look at BSP surfaces, baked lighting, placed local XModels, sky cubemaps, and supported baked water reflections. Leave compiled preview to resume map editing.

tips: The preview does not show compiled model lighting, all material reflections, or PS3 runtime shaders.
If there is no successful BSP in this session, use Open .d3dbsp preview or build one first.
